verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks that push the final outcome of asynchronous processes so integrators can avoid polling, which covers the core idea of event-driven downstream automation. However, the evidence never lists the specific lifecycle event types or ties webhooks to in-person transactions. Refunds and disputes are documented only as API operations, not as webhook events. Missing for 10: an explicit catalog of authorized/captured/refunded/disputed webhook events, POS-specific webhook documentation, subscription/configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
